feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: What to watch this fall: Here are 16 TV shows we're looking forward to
entry.summary: An East of Eden adaptation, a reboot of A Different World, Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson playing (possible) brothers ... Here's a sneak peek at what NPR critics will be watching in the next few months.

entry.title: One year after Charlie Kirk's death, Turning Point USA faces an uncertain future
entry.summary: The death of Charlie Kirk was seen as a rallying call for young conservatives. One year later, the movement is wrestling with questions about its future.

entry.title: After Trump promised to pay $5,000 if Republicans win, here's what to expect Thursday
entry.summary: President Trump promised to send every adult citizen $5,000, but only if Republicans maintain control of Congress in the midterm election, setting high expectations for the convention's final night.

entry.title: Scientists say August was Earth's hottest month they've measured
entry.summary: The European climate service Copernicus said the Earth just sweltered through its hottest month on record in August. Scientists said the heat surge is mostly due to human-caused climate change.

entry.title: A pilot of the Amazon cargo plane in Miami crash warned it was coming in too fast
entry.summary: For nearly two minutes, one of the pilots of the Amazon cargo plane that careened off a Miami runway repeatedly warned his counterpart they were going too fast, according to flight information.

entry.title: Fetterman, already at odds with his party, makes surprise video for GOP convention
entry.summary: The Pennsylvania Democrat has already had a strained relationship with many inside his party. In the video, he spoke about working with Trump but did not outright praise him.

entry.title: Fold the phone: Apple's new CEO unveils a foldable iPhone
entry.summary: New Apple CEO John Ternus announces the iPhone Duo, which folds like a passport and is the most radical iPhone design update in nearly 20 years.

entry.title: Special education head at Education Department abruptly resigns
entry.summary: The leader of the Education Department's special education office told employees she is resigning after less than four months in the role and as the agency overall is morphing and shrinking.

entry.title: Andrew Tate is denied bail and will remain in jail during his extradition fight
entry.summary: Prosecutors told the court that Andrew and Tristan Tate boasted about having multiple passports and flying on private jets. But the Tates' lawyers argued they were only playing a role for their fans.

entry.title: Greetings from Paris, where the 2024 Olympics balloon rises again
entry.summary: The floating Olympic cauldron, held aloft by a giant glowing balloon, is still making regular appearances two years after the 2024 Paris Games, showing up all summer long in the nighttime Paris sky.
